opens_with: the posting's 'I'm interested' link opens 'Easy apply' (personal details first, screening questions after)

fields.shadow_dom: every field sits inside open Shadow DOM web components (spl-input, spl-autocomplete, spl-phone-field, spl-dropzone, spl-textarea, spl-select): document.querySelectorAll does not see them -- search each shadowRoot (Playwright locators and aria snapshots do pierce open shadow roots)
fields.text: First name*, Last name*, Email*, Confirm your email* (the same email twice), LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Website

city.widget: input role=combobox aria-haspopup=listbox aria-autocomplete=list inside spl-autocomplete; listbox hidden until typing
city.pick: type the city, wait for the listbox, click the option that matches

phone.widget: spl-phone-field: a 'Country code' button role=combobox (aria-autocomplete=none) opening a listbox with its own search input ('Search by country/region or code'), plus input type=tel
phone.pick: open the code list, type the country, click it; then type the national number

fields.file: input type=file inside spl-dropzone ('Choose a file or drop it here'); a separate hidden input is the profile photo -- never put the resume there
fields.long_answer: textarea 'Let the company know about your interest working there' (cover note)
fields.screening: later step: questions per job (radio, select, text)
